Plane's BoundedSurface: on reading, it does NOT look like the panic-installing defect the packet describes -- this tree's Plane::parameter_range is the bounded [0,1]^2, so range_tuple().expect(UNBOUNDED_ERROR) cannot fire for it. The defect pattern is real for the new types (both are unbounded in v), which is exactly why decision 6 was followed: neither Cylinder nor Cone implements BoundedSurface. Canonical-placement awkwardness worth recording: (1) the cone's v<0 sheet is the mirror cone opening along -z, so normal(u,v) flips sign across the apex and returns Vector3::zero() at v==0 -- the packet's 'do not lie about the apex' rule; (2) search_parameter has no unique u at the apex/axis, so it returns the hint's u or 0.0 there (Sphere's pole convention), while search_parameter for the cylinder is never degenerate because radius>0; (3) Cone::search_nearest_parameter projects onto the double-cone generator via v=(slope*radial+z)/(1+slope^2), which for an on-axis point lands off the apex; (4) ParameterDivision2D takes the cone's ratio at the widest cross-section over vrange (conservative, over-subdivides near the apex) and the v division is just the two generator endpoints. Ratchet: exactly 4 unscaled_legacy() call sites introduced (Cylinder::search_parameter, Cone::search_parameter, and the two IncludeCurve<BSplineCurve<Point3>> impls); HEAD gate count 17 -> 21, ceiling 29.
